$comment: The guided way in (rails-ops ui-jobs 478): every question, option and destination of /start. Read through lib/start/tree.ts. A node is a question; an option leads to another node (with an intro drawn above it while it is the current question), a results page, the explorer roster or a route. The browse node is reached from both Just browsing? and New to DeFi?. At most three questions deep from the home hero.

browse.question: Which protocol?
browse.line: Type to narrow the list. Each opens on that explorer.

find.question: Which protocol?
find.line: Each opens on that explorer with its wallet search ready. Rails reads the chain, so it answers while the protocol's app is down.

borrow.heading: Explorers whose loans can hold {group}
borrow.line: Each opens on its list of positions, filtered to that collateral where the list takes a filter.
borrow.$comment: Which explorers qualify is derived from the asset catalogs in lib/start/results.ts where a catalog states the collateral; the explorers below have no such catalog, so their answer is written here with its source.

near-liquidation.heading: Explorers that sort positions by how close they are to liquidation
near-liquidation.line: Each list opens with the positions closest to liquidation first.

liquidated.heading: Explorers that list liquidated positions
liquidated.line: Each list opens on positions that have been liquidated, latest activity first.

liquity-v1.note: Liquity V1 takes one collateral, ETH (docs.liquity.org/liquity-v1/readme: loans against Ether). Its listing has no collateral filter.

morpho.note: Morpho Blue markets are permissionless (docs.morpho.org/learn/concepts/market) and the docs name no collateral list. The chain read of Ethereum markets (/api/chain/morpho/markets, 4 Nov 2026) shows ETH, BTC and stablecoin collateral.

morpho-base.note: As Morpho on Ethereum. The chain read of Base markets (/api/chain/morpho-base/markets, 4 Nov 2026) shows ETH, BTC and stablecoin collateral; the listing's collateral filter takes addresses.

fluid.note: The Fluid docs list no collateral. Rails's vault read (/api/chain/fluid/vaults, 4 Nov 2026, 177 vaults) shows ETH, BTC and stablecoin supply sides.

llamalend.note: The Curve docs reachable list no collateral. Rails's market read (/api/chain/llamalend/markets, 4 Nov 2026) shows ETH, BTC and stablecoin collateral (sUSDe, sDOLA, sUSDS and others).

makerdao.note: The Sky docs were not readable. Rails's ilk roster (/api/makerdao/ilk-roster, 4 Nov 2026) holds ETH, WSTETH, RETH and WBTC vault types; the USDC, USDT, TUSD, GUSD and PAXUSD ilks are legacy and left off.

compound.note: The Compound docs name no per-market collateral (docs.compound.xyz/collateral-and-borrowing). Rails's market read (/api/chain/compound/markets, 4 Nov 2026) shows WETH and staked ETH, WBTC, cbBTC and tBTC, and USDe, deUSD, sdeUSD, USDC and USDT across the Comets.

compound-base.note: As Compound on Ethereum. Rails's market read of the Base Comets (/api/chain/compound-base/markets, 4 Nov 2026) shows WETH and staked ETH, cbBTC and tBTC, and USDC and sUSDS.

aave-v3-base.note: The Aave docs reachable list no Base assets. Rails's Pool read (/api/chain/aave-v3-base/market, 4 Nov 2026) shows WETH, cbETH, wstETH, weETH, cbBTC, LBTC, USDC and EURC with a liquidation threshold above zero.

moonwell-base.note: docs.moonwell.fi/moonwell/protocol-information/contracts lists the 21 Base markets without collateral factors. Rails's read (/api/chain/moonwell-base/markets, 4 Nov 2026) shows ETH and staked ETH, cbBTC, LBTC, tBTC, and USDC, EURC, DAI and USDS with a collateral factor above zero.

notAnswered.aave-v4: Aave V4's hubs and spokes are read from the chain; which collateral each spoke takes is not stated in the code. Left out of the Borrowing pages this round.
notAnswered.seamless: Seamless's reserves are read from the chain. Left out of the Borrowing pages this round.
notAnswered.dolomite: Dolomite's markets are read from the chain. Left out of the Borrowing pages this round.
notAnswered.frankencoin: Frankencoin positions name their collateral per position. Left out of the Borrowing pages this round.
notAnswered.pwn: PWN loans take any token as collateral, per loan. Left out of the Borrowing pages this round.
notAnswered.alchemix: Alchemix loans repay themselves from the deposit's yield. Left out of the Borrowing pages this round.
notAnswered.testnets: Explorers on a testnet (Polaris on Sepolia) are left out of every results page.
